_question: Why does ice float on water?

beats.line: Ice floats, so it must just be lighter than water somehow, right?
That is the part everyone assumes. It is true for most substances, but water is the odd one out.
So the same mass takes up more space as ice, which makes it less dense than the liquid it came from.
